taskContracts.objective: Define P78 enterprise developer preview execution contracts and safety boundary only.

inputs.narrowScope: Define P78 execution contracts, subphase boundaries, and enterprise preview safety rules only.
safetyRules: Do not enable founder intake execution, autonomous Q&A, PRD generation execution, agent dispatch, self-healing apply, provider execution, tool execution, worker execution, project mutation, DB writes, network calls, deploy/release/export behavior, package creation, auth/session/user/workspace mutation, compliance certification, legal attestation, or provider spend.
